meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
Agar aap **India mein ₹3000 ke andar running shoes** lena chahte hain, to *best value* ke liye main in models ko priority dunga: **ASICS Patriot / Jolt series**, **Adidas Duramo SL / Runfalcon**, **Nike Revolution / Downshifter / Run Defy**, **Puma Cyclonite Pro / Softride-type models**, aur **Skechers Go Run Consistent / Go Run Elevate**.[1][3][5][8][13]

**Meri practical recommendation**:
- **Best overall for beginners:** **Nike Run Defy** ya **Skechers Go Run Consistent** — recent budget roundups me ye lightweight, comfortable daily-trainer options ke roop me top par aaye hain.[8]
- **Best cushioning/value:** **Skechers Go Run Consistent** — isse plush cushioning aur beginner-friendly ride ke liye highlight kiya gaya hai.[8]
- **Best reliable brand picks:** **ASICS Patriot/Jolt** — YouTube roundups aur budget lists me ye daily 3–5 km runs ke liye suitable बताए गए हैं.[1][3]
- **Best Adidas option:** **Adidas Duramo SL / Runfalcon** — Adidas ke under-₹3000 running options official category pages aur budget lists me milte hain.[3][5]
- **Best Puma option:** **Puma Cyclonite Pro / Galaxy Pro / Softride variants** — Puma India ke under-₹3000 section me multiple discounted options listed hain.[13][16]

**Kaun sa lena chahiye, depends on aapka use-case:**
- **Daily 3–5 km jogging / beginner running:** **ASICS Patriot/Jolt** or **Nike Run Defy**.[1][8]
- **Thoda soft cushioning chahiye:** **Skechers Go Run Consistent**.[8]
- **Brand + style + discounted value:** **Adidas Duramo SL** ya **Puma Cyclonite Pro**.[1][5][13]
- **Sirf sale price par lena hai:** in models ko **MRP par nahi**, sale me ₹2000–₹3000 ke beech milne par hi value-for-money mana gaya hai.[1][3][4]

**Shortlist agar aap 3 options chahte hain:**
1. **Nike Run Defy**  
2. **Skechers Go Run Consistent**  
3. **ASICS Patriot / Jolt 5**[1][8]

Agar aap chahen, main aapke liye **men/women**, **wide feet/narrow feet**, aur **heel-strike/flat-feet** ke hisaab se exact best model shortlist bhi bana deta hoon.
